preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4.
The length of the permutation p is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of elements in all permutations does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is either a permutation of [0, 1, ..., n-1] or -1.
postconditions.description: Each output must be a valid permutation or indicate impossibility.
